faq.q: What is the origin of Fidah?
faq.a: Fidah is associated with Arabic. Fidah is a spelling variant of Fidaa (فداء, fidāʾ), 'ransom, self-sacrifice, devotion'. The source gloss 'little, tiny, separation' is unsupported for this form and has not been carried over.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Fidah, fidah. Script forms are فداء, फ़िदा.

faq.q: Is Fidah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
